rVenue.name: NYSE ARCA OPTIONS
rVenue.materialAspects:
Great Point Capital, LLC (“GPC”) sends options customer orders to Dash Financial Technologies (“Dash”), which provides smart-order routing and access to U.S. options exchanges and alternative trading systems in seeking the most favorable execution terms.
Dash may receive rebates from, or pay access fees to, exchanges in accordance with standard exchange fee schedules. Under GPC’s cost-plus arrangement with Dash, such exchange fees or rebates are passed through at cost, and a flat execution fee is applied by Dash for its services. In certain cases, the net of such fees and rebates may result in a small credit or debit to GPC. These economics are incidental and do not influence routing decisions. GPC does not have any ownership or profit-sharing relationship with Dash or the exchanges listed in this report.
